items.title: TikTok Shop affiliate: who qualifies
hooks: TikTok Shop affiliate commissions commonly pay between 5% and 20%.
You do not need 10,000 followers to earn on TikTok Shop.
Do you meet the follower requirement for TikTok Shop affiliate?
items.caption:
In the US, TikTok Shop creator affiliate access requires 5,000 followers. Standard product commissions range from 5% to 20%. The catch: you must keep up with strict product guidelines, and free samples are never guaranteed until brands approve your pitch.

hooks: Amazon Associates pays commissions between 1% and 10% per sale.
You do not need any followers to join Amazon Associates today.

items.caption:
Amazon Associates accepts accounts with zero followers. Commissions range from 1% to 10% depending on product category. The catch: you must drive 3 qualified sales within 180 days, or Amazon closes your account and revokes access.

items.title: Usage rights: get paid again for the same video
hooks: Brands pay $100 to $500 extra to run your video as ads.
Buying your video does not give brands free paid ad rights.
Are you letting brands run ads using your video for free?
items.caption:
When a brand buys a UGC video, organic posting is included. If they want to run it as a paid ad, charge usage rights. Typical rates are $100 to $500 for 30 to 90 days. The catch: contracts must state time limits clearly, or brands might run ads indefinitely.
